newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESS SECURITY FIRM SHARE ISSUE STARTS.
newsitem.headline: ESS SECURITY FIRM SHARE ISSUE STARTS.

text.p: one of the biggest security firms in Estonia, on Thursday began a public issue of 176,000 shares, Hoiupank Investments said.
The nominal value of the shares will be 10 kroons and the sale price will be 57 kroons. The share issue will expand the company's share capital to 1.176 million shares.

"The new share issue, the company's first step to seeking a listing on the Estonian stock market, will be organised by Houipank Investments and will finish on April 24," Ago Lauri, project manager, with Hoiupank told Reuters.

"The stock market requirments mean that the company cannot be listed on the stock market until 25 percent of its shares are publicly traded and with the new share issue only 15 percent will be publicly trade," Lauri said.
"The owners will start selling some of their shares after the share issue to reach the 25 percent level," he added.
The company has forecast a profit of 11.5 million kroons for 1997 and it 1996 profit was 3.9 million kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400 reuters@reut ers.ee
